name: Herrera de Valdecañas (Spain)
description: A red hoist third bearing two yellow castles and the letter H, the fly divided horizontally blue over white and charged with the crowned municipal arms of Herrera de Valdecañas (a castle on white within a bordure of castles and lions).
history: Municipal flag of Herrera de Valdecañas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: two castles above and below the letter H
